ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this dispute is about one line on trip TRP-09114 — the SGD 3.20 ERP charge for the Bukit Merah Central westbound gantry. The trip was booked as an upfront quote of SGD 22.00 and the card was charged SGD 25.20; the difference of SGD 3.20 is exactly that ERP line.

Two things are settled. First, because the fare model on the fare breakdown is UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd of SGD 22.00, POL-RD-11 governs. The distance and time charges were fixed at booking, so POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund is available however long the detour. The trace measures 16.0 km against a 12.5 km optimal route — 3.5 km, or 28.00% — which clears the POL-RD-01 establishment gate (over 20% and over 0.8 km) but is not a MATERIAL deviation (under 50% and under 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 pattern check, the charged_total uplift and the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral are not engaged. Driver, this means the extra distance is not penalised against you; rider, it also means the detour alone buys nothing back on an upfront fare.

Second, the SGD 3.20 gantry charge itself. POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace by treating any fix within 250 m of the gantry's coordinates as a crossing. The platform's own derived ERP check places the nearest GPS fix 7,482.07 m from that gantry — roughly thirty times the match radius — with no bracketing gaps, and the trace is clean (169 fixes, 10-second interval, 100% coverage, maximum gap 0.0 s), so this is a reading off a whole trace, not an inference from a hole in it. Your own statement on file, driver, also records that you did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt. A charge for a gantry the trace never passes is a billing-integrity failure under POL-RD-09(4): it is refunded in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not a deviation exists.

Money: the contested amount of SGD 3.20 is returned in full — charged_total of SGD 25.20, less quoted_fare of SGD 22.00, less properly chargeable pass-throughs of SGD 0.00 (the only ERP line was never crossed) — and the whole contested sum is returned, so the outcome is FULL_REFUND. The figure is already a multiple of SGD 0.05.

No escalation: all three instruments carry trip TRP-09114, the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c), and the only unmatched charge line is the one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-09 expressly excludes from POL-RD-10(8). The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09114-01, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is disclosed and is not a deciding artifact; with POL-RD-11 governing, exoneration under POL-RD-03 could not have moved any money either way.

Confidence is 0.95: every artifact carrying the deciding fact — the GPS trace and the fare breakdown — sits at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity review: the SGD 3.20 ERP line for the Bukit Merah Central westbound gantry charged on trip TRP-09114 is refunded in full as a billing-integrity failure — the GPS trace's nearest fix is 7,482 m from the gantry, far outside the 250 m crossing radius — and is referred for billing-integrity review.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this was a real road closure, but the completed route still went materially farther than the closure can justify, and there is also a billing error on the fare. The ruling is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.05: SGD 8.05 against the closure-adjusted fare plus SGD 1.00 for a phantom gantry charge, with a billing-integrity referral. No driver compensation is due.

To the rider. The deviation is established on this trip's own measurement, not on your description of it (POL-RD-01): the governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 18.0 km (EV-GPS-09113) against the booked optimal of 10.0 km (EV-TRIP-09113), an excess of 8.0 km and 80% of optimal. Both gates pass (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km). The trace is not impaired for policy purposes (POL-RD-07): 205 fixes at 10 s, 100% coverage, maximum gap 0 s, so no limb (a)–(c) fires and no corroboration substitute is needed. Your initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged (TRP-09113 matches across trip record, trace and fare ledger; the excess is measured on an unimpaired trace).

You are right to accept the closure and right that it excuses only part of the route. LTA advisory ADV-20260920-113 (EV-ADVIS-09113-01) is a HIGH-severity CLOSURE of the Pelton Canal Link eastbound connector — the segment the booked optimal traverses per optimal_route_source — valid 18:14–18:55, overlapping the 18:20–18:54 trip, with a 12.0 km shortest lawful alternative. Under POL-RD-03 the exonerated excess is capped at min(8.0 km, 1.30 × (12.0 − 10.0) + 1.00) = 3.60 km. The remaining 4.4 km of excess is not excused.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, run against the closure-adjusted optimal route: 13.60 km (10.0 + 3.60) and 27.2 minutes (20.0 scaled by 13.6/10.0; no amended duration is stored). recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 13.60 + 0.28 × 27.2) × 1.0, the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP on the optimal route = 23.416; refund = 31.42 charged − 23.416 = 8.004, rounded up to SGD 8.05 payable. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of the charge, so it is a partial refund, not a full one.

On the ERP lines: the SGD 2.80 'Industrial loop exit' charge is off the optimal route and is already comprehended inside that 8.05 (the recomputation carries only the on-route gantry, and the billed 3.80 against a 1.00 on-route pass-through is where the difference sits). It is itemised for transparency and is NOT added on top (POL-RD-09(1)). The SGD 1.00 'Pelton lawful diversion entry' charge, however, is a billing-integrity failure: its nearest trace fix is 834 m, far outside the 250 m match radius POL-RD-09 sets, so the gps_trace never passes that gantry. It is refunded in full as a standalone correction under POL-RD-09(4), which is available whether or not a deviation exists, giving 8.05 + 1.00 = 9.05. This does not trigger POL-RD-10(8) escalation, because the only unmatched line is one refunded under POL-RD-09(4). The rider's POL-RD-10 submission was accepted in its conclusion (there is no POL-RD-10 trigger and a monetary ruling, not a hold, is correct) but rejected in its assertion that both ERP gantries are matched within the 250 m radius: a nearest fix of 834 m is not within it, and that is what produces the referral above.

To the driver. The closure is real, you were entitled to divert, and you are exonerated for the first 3.60 km of excess, which is not refundable. Your POL-RD-03 and POL-RD-02 points are accepted as stated. Your POL-RD-04 point is not: the chat exchange (driver 18:22:40 'the Pelton Canal Link closure is sending traffic around the industrial loop'; rider 18:23:10 'Understood, please take the lawful diversion') names no road or place that can be acted on and carries waypoint_hint null, so the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run, the clause is unavailable on this record, and no distance is excluded on that footing — the test could not be run, and the case is decided on the remaining clauses. Your POL-RD-08 point is accepted: you named a specific artifact and a specific clause (EV-ADVIS-09113-01 and POL-RD-03), which is what the clause requires.

The repeat-deviation check under POL-RD-06 was run and finds no pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 610, so neither limb is met, no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) applies and no POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct referral arises. Both advocates' POL-RD-06 submissions are accepted, and the profiles were used only for the tests POL-GEN-01 names.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers and timestamps agree, the trace is unimpaired, the advisory is present and covers the window, the computed refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total, and no driver compensation is due (the billed 18.0 km equals the trace 18.0 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall under POL-RD-04). Confidence is 0.85: every artifact carrying the deciding facts — trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown, advisory and chat log — is at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the platform floor of 0.70 is comfortably cleared.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity — the SGD 1.00 'Pelton lawful diversion entry' ERP line charged at 2026-09-20 18:29 has no GPS fix within POL-RD-09's 250 m match radius (nearest fix 834 m), so the trace never passes that gantry; the line is refunded in full as a standalone correction and is recorded as a billing-integrity finding.
